findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: During pending verify, Cancel94/input90 are disabled but header/backdrop/Escape still use unrestricted Modal39 close. closeDialog53-59 clears state with no generation invalidation. Old handleVerify closure82-84 unconditionally restores its enrollment backup_codes and reopens backupCodes after fulfillment. Source repro: deferred verify -> close callback -> old fulfillment; NOT executed.
findings.fix: Guard every pending dismissal path and correlate attempt/instance settlement. Never claim abort; old completions must not reopen/reset a newer flow.

findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: Retained session data with fetchStatus paused passes ordinary actions98-100. Hero disables individual pending commands only; has no source-blocked/read-only readiness prop. Controller61/74/107/117 dispatches mutateAsync without current readiness check. Stale page notice53 is informative, not a command gate. This confirms absent UI/dispatch readiness, not a successful offline API call.
findings.fix: Existing local capability/live-readiness prop and dispatch recheck; explain blocked commands while preserving retained data. No offline credential queue/invented capability.

findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: Rejected revoke is caught110 and finally112-113 always clears showDisableConfirm, dropping typed-confirmation recovery. Hook199 emits error toast and no success invalidation on failure; no fake success toast alleged. Existing flow test403 deliberately asserts close-on-failure. Source repro: open confirmation -> rejected promise -> close; NOT executed.
findings.fix: Retain rejected dialog with localized recovery; close/reset after confirmed success or explicit idle Cancel. Owner must deliberately reconcile old close-on-error oracle.

findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: Static apps use purple IconBox38 plus fixed cyan list icons52; guide74 cyan; recovery46 amber plus57 emerald. These informational groupings have no operational severity. IconBox20-26 applies selected mapped bg/ring/foreground. Source decoration confirmed; actual composed contrast/intensity unmeasured.
findings.fix: Existing neutral theme-aware informational roles; retain credential semantic states and QR white scanner backing. No palette/global token rewrite.

findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: Source fixture session activated true,last_used_at whitespace: KPI69-72 forwards truthy whitespace to formatter54-57 -> dash; Hero45 trims and78 labels Never. Same source gets conflicting unknown/never-used meaning. Hero test245 pins whitespace Never; formatter not executed here.
findings.fix: One local validity/absence normalization, keep both summary/detail and existing preference-aware formatter; invalid/missing evidence is not proven never-used.

findings.mechanismAndSourceRepro: Finite negative backupRemaining passes knownNumber378-386, then Math.max0 renders an apparently measured exhausted balance. Invalid negative and genuine0 become indistinguishable. Hero test225 intentionally pins clamp; not a new phase5 regression. No actual negative backend response observed.
findings.fix: Local nonnegative safe-integer validation and distinct unknown/invalid fallback; retain raw payload and real0. Reconcile old clamp oracle at assigned owner.
